svg.title: Speedup of the fastest configuration of each machine
svg.desc: Paired horizontal bars, one panel per release rate, of how many times faster the solver intervals and the whole application of each machine's fastest end-to-end tuple run than the serial build of Mac M4 Max. Measured computational diagnostic of the Sarno six-hour workload; medians of three samples without confidence intervals; not observational validation.
